coordination.G0: Best eligible single expert selected only on inner coffee-group OOF

G3.response: inner OOF primary gap advantage of R1 versus B2

coordination.excluded_M1_reason: Retained training overlaps development; no raw retained M1 development OOF claim
coordination.historical_originals: Unchanged B2 and R1 outputs retained as controls, not known-error components of deployed ensemble
coordination.primary_dynamic_contrast: G3 minus G1 at P1 PRELIMINARY_RESULT, fixed information and five recovery results
coordination.score_alignment: Expertwise midrank percentile over identical candidate universe; not probabilities
coordination.shared_semantics: Canonical direct priority once, compatible broad support +0.25 once, actually exposed NONE -1 once; deduplicate parent/child and feedback paths

data.outer_scope: Nested development evaluation of a new frozen objective; old D0 results previously inspected, not fresh confirmation

descriptor_inputs.candidate_scope: Per outer-train qualified R1 vocabulary intersect legacy FAMILY fine IDs; frozen for all experts and variants; target coverage retained
descriptor_inputs.feedback: One 3–8 candidate exposure after legal preliminary endpoint; choices only from visible A; hidden T never chooses feedback
descriptor_inputs.missing_source_context: Not fabricated; existing source masks retained; synthetic valid context is engineering only
descriptor_inputs.question_policy: Existing fixed R1 planner; all coordination variants share each record/path's actual questions and answers
descriptor_inputs.runtime: Required C0/C1, actually answered options and previously exposed final candidates only

foundation.CHECK: R1 retained; no initial inclusion in coordinator pool or post-hoc hunt for favorable subgroups

information_efficiency.diagnostic_prefixes: All existing stages, including context and Q0/Q1, are curve observations, not new permitted stops
information_efficiency.final_comparison: Candidate count separately included; pre-final and post-final curves separate, no free final correction
information_efficiency.primary_cost_claim: Require lower ordinary option cost and upper paired gap-difference interval <=0.02 on common groups at existing legal endpoints
information_efficiency.target_driven_stopping: FORBIDDEN; thresholds evaluated retrospectively, never control runtime
information_efficiency.threshold_basis: R2 operational research thresholds fixed before results; not validated human acceptability
information_efficiency.threshold_cost: Earliest observed legal terminal endpoint reaching gap<=0.5; failures retained as not reached, never dropped from cost denominator

new_data_policy: New retrieval directions allowed; actual files and rights required. Freeze task-specific incremental controls and confirmation groups before viewing results. No synthetic sample reconstruction from papers.
new_objective_policy: Introduced in R2 before new fits; R1 ranking regressions remain regressions.
per_source_and_subgroups: Diagnostic and exploratory; no unregistered product-wide promotion from nominal local intervals

primary_alignment.aggregation: Coffee-group macro mean after equal record/path/stage weighting within a declared contrast
primary_alignment.explicit_repetition: Entire fixed visible A excluded before taking five; no direct-A identity is counted as new recovery
primary_alignment.formula: 1 - maximum one-to-one matching weight(top5 recovery fine candidates, distinct positive fine T) / number of fine T
primary_alignment.granularity: sensory.* only; compound IDs stay whole; broad descriptors and attributes receive no primary credit
primary_alignment.name: FIXED_TAXONOMY_ONE_TO_ONE_FINE_RECOVERY_GAP_AT_5
primary_alignment.output_interpretation: Counterfactual five-item completion panel; actual full top5/direct retention reported separately; not actual user-display accuracy
primary_alignment.reference: Fixed R1 record-derived hidden T; same positive observations throughout trajectory
primary_alignment.scale: Authored semantic proxy; not calibrated psychological distance or flavor probability
primary_alignment.target_mask: No fine T => null/unidentifiable; no prediction with fine T => gap 1; vocabulary-excluded T remains in denominator

publication: Code, permissible configuration, aggregate metrics and hashes only; raw data, trajectories and weights stay private

task_registry.INDIVIDUAL_PERCEPTUAL_ALIGNMENT: Requires imported actual judgments independent of corrective selections; currently NOT_EVALUATED
task_registry.INFORMATION_EFFICIENCY: Actual offered information budget in fixed legal paths; user-time efficacy NOT_EVALUATED without measured sessions
task_registry.OBSERVED_DESCRIPTOR_RECOVERY: Positive-only source descriptions, fixed A/T; no unmentioned sensory negatives
task_registry.PROFESSIONAL_PROFILE_ALIGNMENT: Native source-coded profile reconstruction MAE, product unit, other-view cells only; separate from descriptor ranks
task_registry.RECORDED_RESPONSE_PREDICTION: Complete CATA ballots with true binary zeros, held participant and held condition separately; no cross-coffee claim from one coffee

uncertainty: Paired independent coffee/participant/condition unit as declared; 2000 fixed-prediction bootstraps for descriptor tasks; <10 groups show range and INCONCLUSIVE, not narrow generalization CI
